reasoning_policy.expert_policy: MAX for material adversarial/certification work on critical security, Unicode/normalization, retained-state or governance surfaces, or contradictory/failing evidence; otherwise HIGH
reasoning_policy.coder_policy: MAX for production-source implementation work combined with critical or multi-signal edge-case risk, or contradictory/failing evidence; otherwise HIGH
reasoning_policy.fail_closed: a successful reviewer run must contain exactly one authoritative final-analysis thinking request with recorded HIGH or MAX effort

transport_resilience.retry_scope: broken transport only: IncompleteRead, URL/connection/timeout failures, or malformed/truncated JSON body
transport_resilience.self_test_gate: scripts/run_review_with_meter.py invokes deepseek_transport.py --self-test before the reviewer subprocess
transport_resilience.recovery_audit: a recovered transport retry is appended to reasoning audit reasons as transport-retry-recovered:N

verdict_emission: same-model non-thinking extractor only when authoritative adaptive HIGH/MAX analysis lacks a complete visible verdict

mandatory_bundle: complete exact content of every BASE-to-HEAD changed file
exact BASE-to-HEAD patch for modified files
deterministic semantic slices for directly imported local qore.infrastructure definitions with bounded referenced helpers
exact frozen repository state, PR binding, HEAD checks and combined commit status
authenticated exact QORE CI summary bound to the declared quality job and synthetic checkout
evidence_contract.planner: one non-thinking bounded planning call for genuinely additional evidence
evidence_contract.search_backend: git grep -n -F -I over tracked qore-core checkout content
evidence_contract.planner_tool_authority: read-only and restricted to frozen qore-core checkout / qore-core GitHub endpoints
evidence_contract.tool_result_policy: exact up to the hard fail-closed gate; no silent pre-clipping

exact_qg_contract.raw_validation: full command windows are fetched, parsed and equality-checked deterministically
exact_qg_contract.model_transport: authenticated identity, exact summaries and command-bound synthetic checkout proof only

governance_note: QORE-DEEPSEEK-V2.1.2-ADAPTIVE is the ordinary stable successor to V2.1.1 for Expert and Coder certification. It preserves V2.1.1 evidence, freeze, token-budget and fail-closed contracts, adds mode-specific HIGH/MAX thinking selection with deterministic reasoning audit, and now includes one explicit bounded retry only for broken authoritative-response transport. HTTP errors are not retried, there is no sleep/backoff, and the transport helper self-tests before paid reviewer execution. Expert and Coder remain independent read-only reviewers and do not gain implementation, merge or Production authority.
